subject: CAIQ closure run: staged deliverables & audit-ready proofset
messages:
From: Ethan Sullivan <ethan.sullivan@greenleaffin.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: security@greenleaffin.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: CAIQ responses + scoped logs for upcoming audit

Hi Aditya,

GreenLeaf is preparing for a CSA review the week of 2026-12-13. Our audit team needs a CAIQ response package targeted at the controls in scope for tenant isolation, key management, and telemetry (roughly CCM: ID.GV - ID.GV-01, KYA - KYA-03, and LOG-02 in our intake). Specifically: 

- Completed CAIQ spreadsheet (we'll prefer the CSV template we shared previously).
- Representative runtime telemetry export showing request routing and tenant-id tags (redacted is fine).
- Keystore rotation audit (sample of rotation events and HSM attestations).

Can Redwood deliver a first-pass CAIQ spreadsheet plus at least one sample log artifact by 2026-12-10? If you can point me at what you plan to upload (SFTP / shared Drive / DocuSign for attestation) that would be helpful.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround on this.

—Ethan
Ethan Sullivan
Security Operations Lead
GreenLeaf Financial
From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: Ethan Sullivan <ethan.sullivan@greenleaffin.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ responses + scoped logs for upcoming audit

Ethan — thanks for the scope. We can support that timeline. Quick plan: 

1) I'll produce a completed CAIQ index (first draft) and upload it to a secured Drive folder by end-of-day 2026-12-03. Attachment: redwood_caiq_index_v0.1.xlsx (placeholder index).
2) Marissa will handle telemetry extraction and provide a redacted sample of routing/tenant tags by 2026-12-08.
3) Jonas will gather keystore rotation evidence (rotation events + KMS/HSM attestations) and provide a sample log; if you need the raw keystore audit we can provide a sanitized excerpt: keystore-audit-sample.log.
4) Priya will prepare a short assertions PDF mapping control IDs to evidence artifacts and owners.

Two clarifying Qs: 
- Do you need the telemetry in raw JSON lines or as a CSV summary?
- For keystore rotation, is a 30-day window sample sufficient or do you need longer?

Uploading approach: we prefer a secured Drive folder (link below) with per-artifact ACLs; if you require SFTP instead we can arrange. I pasted the Drive link in the related_links field and will send the upload invite once artifacts are staged.

Attaching the initial index (v0.1) so internal stakeholders can triage.

Thanks — Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ response plan and deliverables (internal)

Thanks Aditya — looping in specifics so we have a compact runbook: 

- Marissa (me): Telemetry sample (deliverable: telemetry_sample_GL-0912.csv) — will include tenant_id, route, timestamp, and latency columns. ETA 2026-12-08 EOD.
- Jonas: Keystore rotation evidence (deliverable: keystore-audit-sample.log + HSM-attestation.pdf) — ETA 2026-12-07. I will work with infra to redact PII and remove live keys.
- Priya: Control assertions PDF mapping CAIQ questions to Redwood artifacts (deliverable: scoped-assertions-GL-0912.pdf) — ETA 2026-12-03 for first draft.

Notes / action items: 
- Jonas: please confirm size and redaction approach for the log; GreenLeaf asked for a sample that demonstrates rotation cadence and the rotation principal. Keep the sample limited to ~10k lines.
- Priya: use the CAIQ sections that align with tenant isolation and key mgmt; keep the narrative short (1–2 paragraphs per control) and point to artifact filenames.
- Aditya: I'll review before we upload and do one sanity pass for any accidental secrets.

Quoted for context:
> On Tue, 1 Dec 2026 at 11:05 AM aditya_rao@redwood.com wrote:
> Ethan — thanks for the scope. We can support that timeline. Quick plan: 
> 1) I'll produce a completed CAIQ index (first draft) and upload it to a secured Drive folder by end-of-day 2026-12-03. Attachment: redwood_caiq_index_v0.1.xlsx (placeholder index).

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Ethan Sullivan <ethan.sullivan@greenleaffin.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: security@greenleaffin.com
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ closure run: staged deliverables & audit-ready proofset

Aditya / team — this plan works for GreenLeaf. A couple of final asks so we can align our intake: 

- Keystore sample: please include a short header that lists the time window, rotation policy id, and the principal performing rotations. A 30-day window is fine.
- Telemetry format: CSV is acceptable; include a short README in the folder describing column names and any redaction applied.
- Upload: use the Drive folder link you provided and set view/upload permissions to our security team (security@greenleaffin.com). We will pull artifacts directly from Drive.

I'll expect the first artifacts by 2026-12-03 (assertions PDF + CAIQ index v0.1). If you hit any blocker with attestation scans or HSM copies, flag it and we'll accept a signed attestation + note in the PDF.

Thanks everyone — we appreciate the responsiveness.

—Ethan
Ethan Sullivan
Security Operations Lead
GreenLeaf Financial

--End of thread--
